The following events took place in '''6899 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Sorzus Syn]] recovers [[Holocron of King Nakgru]] off [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Exile Second Year">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' (p. 27) states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be 6899 BBY.</ref>
